children: Yorkville Ives remains bullish on Nvidia despite Jensen Huang's departure. The chip maker remains the clear leader in GPU chips for the AI revolution, roughly two to three years ahead of the nearest competitor, the analysts note. They think Nvidia's current valuation is too cheap once it gets through this storm. Meanwhile, Colette Kress is a credible leader for Nvidia to navigate the turmoil while the company could look to the outside for a new chief executive. "A host of names including Apple's Tim Cook as a dark horse candidate in our view given the global importance of Nvidia to the overall U.S. tech industry," they add. Nvidia stock closed down 4.4%. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
